decisions.reason: The complete-teaching-moment clarification does not alter the independently defined clean editing rules; the same message's effects clause is already represented separately.
The teaching-moment clarification does not change caption color, font, or effects; those independent same-message changes are already represented.

The qualification requirement already requires all three clips to meet the applicable standards, and the new teaching-moment details do not change the qualification method, count, deadline, or success condition.
Requiring a complete standalone lesson or story does not change the permitted source, topic constraint, or one-video batch constraint.
Selecting a strong source moment remains valid unchanged; completeness and standalone teaching value are independently captured by the source Requirement.
The source decision adds content-completeness criteria but does not modify the existing 30-to-90-second duration range.
The teaching-moment standard does not change the deferred Lead Clipper pathway, assignment status, training focus, or responsibilities.
The content-quality clarification does not change where or how sample clips must be submitted for review.
The source decision does not change the monthly quota of 125 approved clips or its quota period.
